description: Rename a tab (sheet) inside a Google Sheets spreadsheet. Takes the tab's current title, not its sheetId. Renaming changes only the label: every row, formula and value in the tab is untouched. Ranges that name the old title will stop resolving, so update any saved ranges afterwards.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

title.description: Current title of the tab to rename

name: gws-mcp__sheets_rename_tab
